in_sanskrit.name: वसुमती
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Basumati' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'vasu' which means 'abundant' or 'fertile' and 'mati' which means 'intelligence' or 'wisdom'. This name signifies a woman who is abundant in wealth, intelligence, and wisdom, and is therefore fortunate.

in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lady of the Forest
in_marathi.long_meaning: Basumati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who has a vast intellect and knowledge, just like the depth and expanse of a forest. Basumati is the name of a goddess who is believed to protect and nurture all the creatures in the forest.
